build_eval_args: build evaluation config arguments from pre-training configs and evaluation YAML paths
create_video_model: create a video vision transformer encoder and predictor model with configurable architecture parameters
load_checkpoint: load a trained model checkpoint into encoder, predictor, target encoder, optimizer, and scaler
init_opt: initialize an AdamW optimizer with warmup cosine learning rate and weight decay schedulers
normalize_and_concat: normalize tensor chunks with LayerNorm and concatenate them back together
